_catatan: Nama bangunan, kartu, dan syarat Boss Blind adalah nama resmi game (ST_BalatroLike, bahasa Inggris). Efek diterjemahkan sendiri mengikuti angka dari data 19 November. Bangunan: [nama, pasif ID, pasif EN]; kartu: [nama, efek ID, efek EN]; bossBlinds: [kode, pembatasan, nama, ID, EN].

OneCafe: Bila ada bangunan Kuliner di sebelahnya, mendapat +10 Pengunjung.
Gains +10 Foot Traffic if a Dining building is adjacent.
Mcdonald: Tiap Quick Bites lain di sebelahnya, skor akhirnya +50%.
+50% final score for each adjacent Quick Bites.
Takoyaki: Gain 1 Coin when you clear a Blind.
Bread: Tiap jenis nama bangunan berbeda di sebelahnya, mendapat +8 Pengunjung.
+8 Foot Traffic for each differently named adjacent building.
BrandHotel: Tiap jenis nama bangunan Kuliner berbeda di sebelahnya: +10 Pengunjung dan rasio konversi +40%.
For each differently named adjacent Dining building: +10 Foot Traffic and +40% conversion.
Arcade: Bangunan berulang di sebelahnya dihitung 1 kali lebih banyak.
Adjacent repeating buildings score 1 extra time.
Gacha: Berulang: tiap 15 Pengunjung dihitung 1 kali, tiap kali memberi 15 Poin.
Repeats: scores once per 15 Foot Traffic, 15 Points each time.
DeskGame: Saat ditaruh, ambil 1 kartu dari dek (tidak bisa dibatalkan).
On placement, draw 1 card (cannot be undone).
Cinema: Tiap 20 Pengunjung yang didapat, bangunan di sekitarnya mendapat +5 Poin tiap kali dihitung.
For every 20 Foot Traffic it gets, surrounding buildings gain +5 Points each time they score.
ThemePark: Berulang: tiap 20 Pengunjung dihitung 1 kali; pertama 20 Poin, tiap hitungan berikutnya bertambah 3 Poin.
Repeats: scores once per 20 Foot Traffic; 20 Points first, each later time is worth 3 more.
StreetShop: Selama ada di papan, tiap tukar kartu memberi 1 Koin.
While on the board, each card swap gives 1 Coin.
Konbini: Bila semua petak di sebelahnya terisi bangunan, mendapat 1 Koin.
Gain 1 Coin if all adjacent cells have buildings.
LargeStore: Hitungan pertama: 1 Koin tiap 2 jenis nama bangunan di papan; hitungan berikutnya 1 Koin.
First scoring: 1 Coin per 2 building names on the board; 1 Coin each time after.
LuxuryHall: Bila Pengunjungnya mencapai kapasitas, mendapat 2 Koin.
Gain 2 Coins if its Foot Traffic reaches capacity.
InvestCenter: Tiap 1 Koin yang dihasilkan bangunan Belanja di Blind ini, rasio konversinya +15%; saat lolos Blind mendapat 3 Koin.
+15% conversion per Coin earned by Retail buildings this Blind; gain 3 Coins on clear.
LittleGreen: Saat ditaruh, hapus efek negatif 1 bangunan di sebelahnya dan kapasitasnya +10 di Blind ini.
On placement, cleanse 1 adjacent building and give it +10 capacity this Blind.
CityGarden: Hitungan pertama: +20 Poin tiap jenis nama bangunan berbeda di sebelahnya.
First scoring: +20 Points per differently named adjacent building.
RainGarden: Aura: bangunan penghasil poin di sebelahnya mendapat kapasitas +40 (aura sejenis tidak menumpuk).
Aura: adjacent scoring buildings get +40 capacity (same aura does not stack).
GreenHall: Aura: bangunan penghasil poin di sebelahnya mendapat rasio konversi +60% (aura sejenis tidak menumpuk).
Aura: adjacent scoring buildings get +60% conversion (same aura does not stack).
WishFountain: Aura: bangunan di sebelahnya yang juga bersebelahan dengan bangunan Alam lain mendapat kapasitas +60 dan konversi +60%.
Aura: an adjacent building that also touches another Nature building gets +60 capacity and +60% conversion.
Metro: Menjangkau 2 petak searah baris dan kolomnya; bangunan penghasil poin dalam jangkauan mendapat +15 Pengunjung.
Reaches 2 cells along its rows and columns; scoring buildings in range get +15 Foot Traffic.
BikeStation: Bangunan penghasil poin dalam 1 petak di sekelilingnya (termasuk diagonal) mendapat +10 Pengunjung.
Scoring buildings within 1 cell around it (diagonals included) get +10 Foot Traffic.
TrafficStation: Menghasilkan 40 Pengunjung sementara yang dibagikan ke bangunan paling menguntungkan.
Creates 40 temporary Foot Traffic, assigned where it earns the most.
CommuHouse: Bila kedua ujung sisi pendeknya diapit bangunan penghasil poin yang sudah mendapat Pengunjung dari transportasi, keduanya mendapat +50 Pengunjung dan konversi +50%.
If both short ends touch scoring buildings already fed by transit, both get +50 Foot Traffic and +50% conversion.
BuildSite: Hitungan pertama: berubah menjadi bangunan acak seukuran di sebelahnya.
First scoring: turns into a random same-size adjacent building.
TempStore: Memiliki semua tema: Kuliner, Hiburan, Belanja, Alam, Transportasi, dan Umum.
Counts as every theme: Dining, Entertainment, Retail, Nature, Transit and General.
LoanCenter: Tiap tukar 1 kartu: +15 Pengunjung dan skor akhirnya +20%; direset setelah dihitung.
Each swapped card: +15 Foot Traffic and +20% final score; resets after scoring.

NailHouse: Tiap bangunan yang keempat sisinya terkepung: +0,2 pengali.

CityObserver: Tiap jenis nama bangunan di papan: +10 Poin.

LevelUp: Tiap memakai Power Card Renovasi, kartu ini mendapat +15 Poin.

Buildings affected by 3+ Transit buildings get +200% conversion.
LastStand: Pada hitungan terakhir di Blind ini, pengali ×2.
On the last scoring of the Blind, ×2 mult.
FirstCharge: Aturan: hitungan pertama pengali ×3; skor hitungan kedua menjadi 0.
Rule: first scoring ×3 mult; the second scoring gives 0.

Gains ×0.1 mult for each building card added to the deck.
Ramen: Pengali ×2; tiap menukar 1 kartu, kartu ini kehilangan ×0,02.
×2 mult; loses ×0.02 for each card swapped.
CoreTeam: Bila memegang paling banyak 4 kartu strategi (termasuk ini), pengali ×3,5.
If you hold 4 or fewer strategy cards (this included), ×3.5 mult.

Rule: on first scoring with 50+ Coins, pay 10 for ×2.5 mult this Blind.

If 2+ Power Cards were played this turn, ×2.5 mult.

Each building card with a positive modifier in the deck adds 0.2 to this card's multiplier.
UrbanArtery: Bila minimal 20 bangunan mendapat bonus Transportasi, pengali ×3.
With 20+ buildings boosted by Transit, ×3 mult.
FlagshipStore: Bila ada bangunan Kuliner yang menghasilkan 100 Poin atau lebih, pengali ×2.
If a Dining building makes 100+ Points, ×2 mult.
HeadlineStar: Bila 1 bangunan Hiburan dihitung minimal 6 kali, pengali ×2.
If one Entertainment building scores 6+ times, ×2 mult.
ParallelTransit: Bila ada 2 bangunan Transportasi bersebelahan: +2,5 pengali.
+2.5 mult if two Transit buildings are adjacent.

+0.6 mult per Transit building that supplies Foot Traffic.

Swashbuckler: Tiap 1 Koin harga jual kartu strategi lain: +0,1 pengali.

Gains +0.2 mult per Repair or Demolish.

BrandFranchise: Tiap pasang bangunan Kuliner di papan: +0,8 pengali.

With 3+ strategy cards and matching top and bottom rarity, +2 mult.

+0.6 mult per distinct positive modifier on the board.

+0.6 mult per kind of Dining building next to a differently named one.
Biodiversity: Tiap tema bangunan non-Alam yang terkena tiap jenis aura: +0,5 pengali.
+0.5 mult for each theme each aura affects.
NightEconomy: Tiap bangunan Belanja: +0,3 pengali; pada hitungan terakhir Blind menjadi +0,6.
+0.3 mult per Retail building; +0.6 on the last scoring.

+0.4 mult per kind of building filled to capacity with transit Foot Traffic.

Gains +0.3 mult per non-Transit building demolished.

+0.5 mult per scoring of your most-scoring Entertainment building.

After demolishing 4+ non-Transit cells this Blind, +2 mult per Transit building.
NewTransitRoute: Tiap bangunan yang dipengaruhi Transportasi: kartu ini +0,02 pengali.
+0.02 mult per building affected by Transit.

+15 Points per scoring building fed by Transit.

StrengthInNumbers: Tiap kartu strategi yang dimiliki (termasuk ini): +0,3 pengali.
+0.3 mult per strategy card held (this included).

+100 Points if you hold a building card.

+40 Points per Power Card in the full deck.

bossBlinds: Skor bangunan yang menempati lingkar terluar papan turun 50% saat dihitung.
Reduces the score of buildings occupying the board's outermost ring by 50% when they score.
Saat bangunan dihitung, skornya turun 8% untuk tiap jenis bangunan lain bertema sama di papan.
Reduces a building's score by 8% for each distinct building type of the same theme on the board whenever it scores.
Mult dasar dan efek tambahan bangunan 2 petak atau lebih dibagi dua.
Halves base Mult and additional effects for buildings occupying 2 or more tiles.
Poin dari semua sumber turun 25% selama permainan ini.
Reduces points earned from all sources by 25% for this run.
Bila terjadi kemacetan, poin pada hitungan itu menjadi 0.
Sets the points earned in the current scoring attempt to 0 if Congestion occurs.
Semua bangunan terkena Pollution selama Blind ini.
Applies Pollution to all buildings for this Blind.
Applies Weakened to all buildings with the Entertainment attribute.
Applies Weakened to all buildings with the Dining attribute.
Bangunan bertema paling banyak di dekmu terkena Debt.
Applies Debt to buildings of the most common theme in your deck.
Tiap menukar kartu dipotong 10 Koin; tidak bisa menukar bila Koin kurang dari 10.
Deducts 10 Coins each time you swap cards. Prevents card swaps if you have fewer than 10 Coins.
Setelah tiap tukar kartu atau hitungan, hanya menarik 3 kartu.
Draws 3 cards after each card swap or scoring attempt.
Skor yang dibutuhkan naik lebih tinggi lagi.
Increases the required score even further.
Empat petak terbuka yang dipilih acak sementara tidak bisa dibangun.
Four randomly selected plots that are currently available are temporarily blocked from building placement.
Tiap bangunan terkena Lockdown 1 giliran setelah dihitung.
Applies 1 turn of Lockdown to each building after it scores.
Setelah dihitung, 1 bangunan acak di papan hancur.
Destroys 1 random building on the board after scoring.
1 Strategy Card acak disegel (kemampuannya mati), tetap tersegel walau posisinya diubah.
Seals 1 random Strategy Card, disabling its ability, and keeps that card sealed even if its position changes.
Semua bangunan terkena Nailed Down selama Blind ini.
Applies Nailed Down to all buildings for this Blind.
